items.stem: An auditor performs only a walkthrough of a control and concludes it is operating effectively all year. The main weakness is that:

options.text: A walkthrough confirms design, not operating effectiveness over the period
options.rationale: Correct: operating effectiveness needs testing across the period, not a single walkthrough.
Walkthroughs are useful for understanding design.
Owner approval does not establish effectiveness.
Auditors must remain independent of the controls.

items.explanation: Correct: operating effectiveness needs testing across the period, not a single walkthrough.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A GRC audit finding describes repeated late access reviews. The most valuable addition to the finding is:

options.text: The root cause of why reviews are late
options.rationale: Correct: identifying root cause enables effective remediation.

options.text: A longer list of the same symptoms
options.rationale: More symptoms without root cause add little value.

options.text: The auditor's personal opinion of staff
options.rationale: Personal opinions are not appropriate audit content.

options.text: A decision to hide the finding

items.explanation: Correct: identifying root cause enables effective remediation.

items.stem: To preserve audit independence while reviewing a GRC capability, which TWO practices apply? (Select TWO)

options.text: The auditor does not design or operate the controls being tested
options.rationale: Correct: independence requires separation from the controls audited.

options.text: Findings are reported without management altering the conclusions
options.rationale: Correct: management cannot override audit conclusions.

options.text: The auditor accepts a bonus tied to a clean report
options.rationale: A bonus for a clean result impairs independence.

options.text: The auditor skips testing to save time
options.rationale: Skipping testing undermines the audit, not independence.

items.explanation: Correct: independence requires separation from the controls audited. Correct: management cannot override audit conclusions.
